quote.text: In every walk with nature, one receives far more than he seeks.
quote.author: John Muir

fun_fact.text: In Hungary, July 27th is traditionally associated with the 'Seven Sleepers' folk weather prediction. According to tradition, if it rains on this day, it will rain for the next seven weeks! This old weather folklore was taken quite seriously by Hungarian farmers planning their harvests.

short_read.title: The Secret Lives of Harbor Seals in the Salish Sea
short_read.teaser: Harbor seals in the waters around Port Angeles have fascinating behaviors, from their underwater songs to their cozy haul-out spots on rocky shores. Learn what makes these charming marine mammals so special to the Pacific Northwest.

medium_read.title: The Ancient Art of Hungarian Kitchen Gardens
medium_read.teaser: For centuries, Hungarian households have cultivated beautiful kitchen gardens filled with peppers, tomatoes, and herbs that define traditional cuisine. This exploration of 'konyhakert' reveals how these gardens connect families to their heritage and the rhythms of the seasons.

long_read.title: Olympic National Park: A Wilderness for All Seasons
long_read.teaser: From temperate rainforests to alpine meadows and rugged coastline, Olympic National Park contains remarkable ecological diversity within its nearly one million acres. This comprehensive guide explores the natural wonders that make this Pacific Northwest treasure so extraordinary.

port_angeles.title: Bald Eagles Along the Strait
port_angeles.description: July is an excellent time to spot bald eagles along the Strait of Juan de Fuca, especially near Ediz Hook and the waterfront. These magnificent birds are often seen perching in tall trees or soaring above the water, hunting for salmon and other fish in the rich waters.

puzzle_1.question: A hummingbird's heart beats approximately ___ times per minute while at rest.
puzzle_1.correct_response: Exactly right, Barbara! That tiny heart is working incredibly hard, even when the bird is just sitting still!
puzzle_1.close_response: Very close! A hummingbird's resting heart rate is about 250 beats per minute — amazing for such a tiny creature!
puzzle_1.wrong_response: A hummingbird's heart beats about 250 times per minute at rest — and over 1,200 times per minute when flying! Their hearts are truly remarkable little engines.
puzzle_1.learn_more_text: When actively flying, a hummingbird's heart rate can soar to more than 1,200 beats per minute! These tiny birds have the highest metabolism of all animals relative to their size.

puzzle_2.question: Which Hungarian word means 'butterfly'?
puzzle_2.correct_response: Wonderful! 'Pillangó' is indeed the Hungarian word for butterfly — such a lovely, musical word!
puzzle_2.wrong_response: The Hungarian word for butterfly is 'pillangó' — doesn't it sound beautiful? It's one of those words that seems to flutter off the tongue!
puzzle_2.learn_more_text: The word 'pillangó' may derive from an old Hungarian word related to fluttering or dancing. Hungary is home to over 200 species of butterflies, including the beautiful swallowtail.

puzzle_3.question: What unique feature helps sea otters avoid drifting away while they sleep?
options: They hold hands with other otters
puzzle_3.correct_response: Yes! Sea otters hold hands while sleeping to stay together — it's called a 'raft.' One of nature's sweetest behaviors!
puzzle_3.wrong_response: Sea otters actually hold hands while they sleep to keep from drifting apart! Groups of resting otters are called 'rafts,' and this adorable behavior keeps families together.
puzzle_3.learn_more_text: Sea otters often wrap themselves in kelp as well, creating a natural anchor. The Strait of Juan de Fuca is part of their historical range, though they're more common further north now.
